main.subtitle: Worksuite
main.title: Manage Your Business from One Smart Workspace
main.content: Bring your teams, projects, communication, and daily operations together in a single platform. Weblings Workspace helps businesses collaborate efficiently, stay organized, and get more done with less effort.

features.subtitle: Streamline
features.title: Streamline Your Business Operations
content: Simplify everyday workflows and keep every department connected. Track projects, manage clients, organize teams, approve timesheets, and monitor business performance from one centralized workspace.

features.subtitle: eOffice
features.title: Go Paperless with eOffice
content: Digitize your workplace by replacing paperwork with secure digital processes. Store documents, manage approvals, organize employee records, and access business information anytime from anywhere.

features.subtitle: Calendar
features.title: Plan Every Day with Smart Calendar
content: Stay ahead of meetings, project deadlines, leave schedules, and company events. The integrated calendar keeps everyone informed and ensures important activities are never missed.
features.imageAlt: Plan Every Day with Smart Calendar

features.subtitle: Chat
features.title: Collaborate Instantly with Team Chat
content: Communicate faster with secure real-time messaging. Share files, discuss projects, create group conversations, and keep everyone connected without switching between multiple applications.

demo.subtitle: Video Section
demo.title: See Weblings Workspace in Action
demo.description: Watch how organizations simplify operations, improve collaboration, and increase productivity using a single digital workspace built for modern businesses.

comparison.title: How much you can save
comparison.titleDescription: Reduce software costs by replacing multiple business tools with one unified workspace. Pay only for what your team needs and scale as your business grows.
